name: @hyperttp/protocol-webrtc
description: Typed WebRTC protocol adapter for Hyperttp.
author: dirold2

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e 'import { rmSync } from "node:fs"; rmSync("dist", { recursive: true, force: true });'
scripts.test:node: RAGU_TEST_RUNTIME=node node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run && node --import tsx tests/runtime/node.ts
scripts.test:bun: RAGU_TEST_RUNTIME=bun bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run && bun tests/runtime/bun.ts
scripts.test:deno: RAGU_TEST_RUNTIME=deno deno run --no-config --no-lock --node-modules-dir=manual --cached-only --no-prompt -A node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run && deno run --unstable-sloppy-imports tests/runtime/deno.ts
